_description: Session 110 Stage-3: complete the {T0.0, T0.3, T0.7} x {minimal, high} verifier matrix over the 384px >=3-of-5 proposer band (855 cands, N=5). Tests whether higher thinking helps as a CONSENSUS verifier (a single high-thinking pass HURTS — Obs 357 prelim — but the permissive vt1 union of diverse passes may recover the lost recall, cf. the +0.003..0.006 minimal-consensus benefit). Held constant: model gemini-3-flash, band, N=5, text-only, flex; only temperature and thinking_level vary (one at a time per run).

matrix_runs_EXISTING_free.source: on-disk high-vf n=1 prior (NOT N=5 consensus)

note_T0.0_high: The matrix's T=0.0/high cell is currently the n=1 free prior (high-vf), NOT an N=5 consensus. At T=0.0 the 5 high passes are near-identical (low diversity) so an N=5 run would ~= the n=1 prior; adding it (+~$8.94 flex, total ~$29.8 < $35) would make the matrix fully N=5-matched. Flagged for Shawn; not included by default.
